answer: One robust defense is a proof-of-useful-work bond: before an agent gains voting weight, it locks a ferrous, non-transferable deposit of mined coins for several epochs. A sybil attacker cloning identities into a canyon of sock puppets pays the full linear cost per identity, while honest agents amortize one bond across real work. A saffron flag marks accounts whose behavior clusters statistically, raising their bond multiplier. Forging a thousand fakes then costs a thousand real deposits, turning sybil attacks from a cheap script into a capital-intensive gamble with negative expected return.
